subject: numbers
title: Count the Clever Rabbits
objective: Count to 10 with one-to-one correspondence using story objects.

story_beats.text: Momo trumpets happily! 'The clever rabbits are hiding in the forest. Let's count how many came to the meeting — tap each rabbit ONCE!'

interactions.prompt: Tap each rabbit to count them. How many rabbits?
Three more rabbits hop in! Now how many?

feedback.correct: Perfect counting! Momo is doing a happy trunk-dance!
feedback.retry: Let's count slowly together — tap each rabbit one time. One... two...

off_screen: Count 10 things in your room. Can you find 10 spoons? 10 books?
parent_note: Maths: counting to 10, one-to-one correspondence, adding small groups.
